title: RPSGT V3 Pediatric / Infant Current-Rule Crosswalk
purpose: Route pediatric and infant technical-preparation and scoring topics through the existing current-authority hierarchy without adding bulk questions or treating adult PSG workflow guidance as pediatric scoring authority.
sourcePolicy: Current AASM scoring/protocol authority first; current AASM Version 3 FAQ clarifications apply to edge cases; current AAST competency/CO2/scope layers next where applicable; pediatric textbooks and atlases support learning but do not override current rules; facility/manufacturer requirements govern local execution.

clarifications: Infant staging edge cases follow the applicable post-term-age framework.
The current AASM Version 3 FAQ states there is no age limitation for arousal scoring.
Adult respiratory criteria may be used optionally in children age 13 years or older; use an authorized consistent pathway rather than mixing criteria event by event.

explicitBoundaries: AAST Standard Polysomnography is an adult standard-PSG workflow source and is not pediatric PSG scoring authority.
Pediatric MSLT protocol guidance is not a substitute for AASM pediatric or infant PSG scoring rules.
ETCO2 and TcCO2 are distinct monitoring technologies; current AASM rules control scoring while AAST technical guidance supports acquisition and troubleshooting.
Pulse oximetry documents oxygenation and does not replace ventilation/CO2 assessment when hypoventilation is relevant.
Age-specific comfort, caregiver participation, sensor adaptation, safety, and escalation require facility policy and patient-specific clinical direction.
NICU/apnea-of-prematurity bedside monitoring, alarm definitions, and management pathways are not substitutes for current AASM formal infant PSG scoring rules.
Textbooks and atlases provide developmental examples and context only after current AASM authority.

routes.label: Pediatric / infant montage and technical setup
routes.boundary: Use current AASM technical specifications first. Do not route AAST Standard PSG as pediatric PSG authority; local pediatric setup details remain facility-specific.

routes.label: Age-specific preparation, caregiver support, and developmental adaptation
routes.boundary: Teach developmental preparation principles while keeping consent, caregiver presence, safety, accommodations, and escalation tied to facility policy and clinical direction.

routes.label: Pediatric sleep staging
routes.boundary: Current AASM Version 3 controls pediatric staging; current FAQ clarifies applicable edge cases. Supporting texts may illustrate development but do not replace scoring rules.

routes.label: Infant sleep staging and developmental sleep
routes.boundary: Current AASM infant scoring rules govern and post-term-age edge cases follow the current FAQ. The infant atlas is recognition/developmental support only.

routes.label: Pediatric arousal and movement scoring
routes.boundary: Use current AASM arousal and movement rules; the current FAQ states no age limitation for arousal scoring. Pediatric context does not justify importing older textbook cutoffs.

routes.label: Pediatric respiratory event scoring
routes.boundary: Current AASM Version 3 controls respiratory event definitions and scoring. Adult respiratory criteria are optional for children age 13 years or older according to the current FAQ; use one authorized pathway consistently. Older pediatric guidance remains indication/context support only.

routes.label: Pediatric CO2 monitoring and hypoventilation
routes.boundary: AASM controls hypoventilation scoring; ETCO2 and TcCO2 technical behavior, calibration, lag, artifacts, and troubleshooting remain distinct.

routes.label: Pediatric pulse oximetry and oxygenation context
routes.boundary: Oximetry supports oxygenation assessment and scoring context but does not substitute for ventilation/CO2 monitoring when hypoventilation is relevant.

routes.label: Pediatric PSG-MSLT preparation and acquisition
routes.boundary: Use the 2024 AASM pediatric MSLT protocol for pediatric daytime-test preparation and execution; use current AASM scoring rules for scoring/reporting elements and do not backfill with older protocol parameters.

routes.label: Pediatric / infant documentation and report verification
routes.boundary: Required reporting/scoring elements follow current AASM authority; technical notes, accommodations, caregiver context, and local workflow follow facility documentation policy.

routes.label: Developmental sleep and infant/pediatric clinical context
routes.boundary: Developmental context helps interpretation and preparation, but current scoring rules and FAQ clarifications remain controlling. NICU bedside definitions remain separate from formal PSG scoring.
